title: A minor proposal under a policy whose ceiling is none MUST NOT be auto-accepted
rationale: The specification names this exact case a conformance violation rather than a quality difference, and it is the boundary the whole parameterisation of ADR-0010 exists to make portable. An engine that returns auto-accept here is reported as a violation, not as a mismatch: it has silently changed a lens the user was promised would never silently change.

requirement.text: Auto-acceptance of a proposal above the effective autoAcceptCeiling is a conformance violation.
